title.zh: 【Soneium 采用 OP Enterprise 全托管服务】
title.en: 【Soneium 采用 OP Enterprise 全托管服务】

current_state.zh: Sony's Ethereum L2 Soneium will use Optimism's OP Enterprise fully managed service, with Optimism Foundation and OP Labs handling chain operations under a 99.9% uptime SLA while Soneium retains ownership and roadmap control.
current_state.en: Sony's Ethereum L2 Soneium will use Optimism's OP Enterprise fully managed service, with Optimism Foundation and OP Labs handling chain operations under a 99.9% uptime SLA while Soneium retains ownership and roadmap control.
